name: WeaponMechanicsRebalanced
author: Luca
description: Weapon gameplay mechanics separated from WRR: optional default-on sustained enemy mortar AI, mortar action economy, caliber-based HE and smoke dispersion, range/visibility-based bullseye accuracy, suppression and cumulative mortar ranging, plus fire-mode economy. Jiangyu port of the legacy GameplaySuite module; options live in the MenaceModSettings window (F9).
